process.title: Implement chaocipher.py (dual-table digraph-evolution cipher) with tests
process.scope: Owns exactly chaocipher.py and tests/test_chaocipher.py. Does not touch centroid.py, base62.py, any other test file, or any existing file. Standard library only; no imports from other deliverable modules.
process.task:
Implement the Chaocipher module exactly to the acceptance section below, then write its test file. Only create these two new files; do not modify any existing file. Use only the standard library and do not import the other deliverable modules.

SPEC:
- Initial alphabets are pinned: left table (ciphertext side) `HXUCZVAMDSLKPEFJRIGTWOBNYQ`, right table (plaintext side) `PTLNBQDEOYSFAVZKGJRIHWXUMC`; both are permutations of A-Z.
- `chaocipher_encrypt(text: str) -> str`: preprocess to uppercase, keep only A-Z. Encrypt letter by letter: find the plaintext letter's index in the right table; the ciphertext letter is the left table char at that same index. After each letter, permute both tables in this order (indices 0-based): (1) left table: first rotate so the just-produced ciphertext letter sits at index 0, then take the letter at index 1 and insert it at index 13; (2) right table: first rotate so the just-consumed plaintext letter sits at index 0, then rotate the whole table left by one, then take the letter at index 2 and insert it at index 13. Empty string returns empty string; non-str raises TypeError.
- `chaocipher_decrypt(cipher: str) -> str`: inverse operation (same preprocessing; find the ciphertext letter's index in the left table, plaintext letter is the right table char at that index; permutation rules as above, driven by the recovered plaintext letter and the ciphertext letter). Empty string returns empty string; non-str raises TypeError.

ACCEPTANCE (transcribed item by item; every item needs a test case):
- `chaocipher_encrypt("A") == "P"`
- `chaocipher_encrypt("AAAA") == "PKLS"`
- `chaocipher_encrypt("HELLOWORLD") == "WAHQVICHTD"`
- `chaocipher_decrypt("WAHQVICHTD") == "HELLOWORLD"`
- `chaocipher_encrypt("CHAOCIPHER") == "QTLVOFOEYS"`
- `chaocipher_decrypt("QTLVOFOEYS") == "CHAOCIPHER"`
- `chaocipher_encrypt("THEQUICKBROWNFOX") == "XTVXVJGSTKDBISJS"`
- `chaocipher_encrypt("") == ""`
- `chaocipher_encrypt("hello world") == chaocipher_encrypt("HELLOWORLD")` (preprocessing)
- `chaocipher_encrypt("HELLO, WORLD!") == "WAHQVICHTD"` (non-letters stripped)
- Round-trip: `chaocipher_decrypt(chaocipher_encrypt(t)) == t` for t in "HELLOWORLD", "THEQUICKBROWNFOXJUMPSOVERTHELAZYDOG", "A", "ZZZZ"
- `chaocipher_encrypt(123)`, `chaocipher_encrypt(None)`, `chaocipher_decrypt(b"WAHQ")` raise TypeError

There are no body-vs-acceptance contradictions for this module; no conflict note applies.

After implementing, run the checks from the repository root and fix any failure before finishing.
